native_lock.note: the success and cancel sessions ran before the session wrapper wrote the lock owner file; no other COS Desktop process existed at those times. The locked session acquired owner=<app pid>, serialized the run and removed the lock afterwards (LOCK_RELEASED in the log).

panel_open_control.detail: diagnostics-toggle, ControlType.Button, Name 診断情報を閉じる, IsKeyboardFocusable=True; UIA InvokePattern opened the panel and exposed support-preview-button (session-success/cancel/locked).

preview_control.detail: support-preview-button, ControlType.Button, Name サポート情報を表示, IsKeyboardFocusable=True, enabled, on-screen; absent while the panel is closed, present after opening.

export_control.detail: support-export-button, ControlType.Button, Name サポート情報をエクスポート, IsKeyboardFocusable=True, enabled; rendered only after a preview exists (absent before preview, present after Enter on the preview button).

preview_text.detail: support-preview-readonly, ControlType.Text, IsKeyboardFocusable=False (read-only, not a Tab stop); Name is the rendered report.

status_text.detail: support-export-status appears after an export outcome; on success the element Name read 保存しました (success session). No path or report text is part of the status.

tab_forward.detail: from a verified-focused diagnostics-toggle, Tab step 0 = support-preview-button, step 1 = support-export-button (tab-forward.txt, identical in all three logged sessions).

tab_backward.detail: Shift+Tab from a verified-focused support-export-button: step 0 = support-preview-button, step 1 = diagnostics-toggle (tab-backward.txt).

status_is_not_a_tab_stop.detail: 24 forward Tab steps and 24 backward steps contained no support-export-status element (TAB_FWD_HAS_STATUS=False); it is a Role::Label with IsKeyboardFocusable=False.

save_dialog_entry_point.detail: Enter on the focused support-export-button opened the native dialog #32770 named 名前を付けて保存 (success and cancel sessions).

cancel_path.detail: Escape closed the #32770 dialog; the target file did not exist afterwards; the trace recorded dialog=Cancelled;data=Rejected;writer=NotStarted;ui=StatusPreserved (cancel session).

success_save.detail: saved 573 bytes with no BOM, SHA-256 equal to the preview text, status 保存しました, trace dialog=Selected;data=Ready;writer=Success;ui=StatusUpdated (success session).

report_bounds.detail: 573 UTF-8 bytes, 19 lines, no BOM; within the recorded 12,288-byte / 24-line ceiling. The report states Source: fixture and Runtime version unknown.

already_exists_native_wording.detail: no overwrite-path attempt was made in this slice.

screen_reader_quality.detail: UIA tree only; no screen-reader output was captured.

runtime_provider_logs.detail: the fixture report contains no Runtime/Provider logs; Runtime version is unknown because observation does not expose it.

export_policy.detail: format, destination, retention and consent are not decided or changed by this slice.
